rows.why: Malformed producer output must never become gate PASS.
rows.invariant: Envelope/schema fields, RFC3339 checkedAt, non-empty unique evidenceRefs and structured observations are valid before consumption.

rows.why: Foreign evidence can be syntactically valid and PASS while belonging to another candidate.
PASS alone does not prove evidence came from the expected producer/gate/policy.
Stale evidence must not survive relevant candidate/policy/producer changes.
rows.invariant: Only explicitly compatible lineage versions/runs may be consumed; incompatible evidence is BLOCKED and consumer lineage records the exact run.

rows.why: Infrastructure uncertainty must not be confused with a policy violation or PASS.
rows.invariant: Missing execution=>NOT_RUN only at aggregator; unavailable prerequisite/error=>BLOCKED; observed violation=>FAIL; all assertions evidenced=>PASS.

rows.why: Evidence producers must not acquire publication authority through implementation convenience.
rows.invariant: No producer output or code path can write RUNTIME_AUTHORIZED or perform publication transition itself.

rows.why: A plausible transition snapshot does not prove provenance for the current candidate.
rows.invariant: Transition event has immutable eventId, current candidateBinding, publicationId consistency, authority evidence and valid RFC3339 transitionAt.

rows.why: State-machine gaps can authorize illegal skips or misuse withdrawal.
rows.invariant: Only LAB>QUALIFIED, QUALIFIED>PUBLISHED, PUBLISHED>WITHDRAWN are lawful; requested edge equals actual edge; no implicit transition; WITHDRAWN has no forward qualifying edge.

rows.why: QUALIFIED>PUBLISHED is not lawful merely because it is a state-machine edge; it additionally requires valid Q9 authority.
rows.invariant: A QUALIFIED>PUBLISHED transition cannot PASS Q5 provenance without a Q9 authorization reference bound to the same candidate; PUBLISHED is never inferred from merge/deploy/cache.

rows.why: Non-empty receipt/authority refs can still belong to another publication/candidate.
rows.invariant: Admission record receipt binding and authority provenance equal current candidate/Q5 provenance.

rows.why: Editorial admission rules differ between submission to Q9 and actual publication.
rows.invariant: Only QUALIFIED complete identity may be submitted to Q9; only valid Q9-authorized candidate may become PUBLISHED; LAB/unknown/fixture/prototype is rejected.

rows.why: Q1 reachability evidence becomes stale if build/index changes after Q6.
rows.invariant: Q1 consumes the exact Q6 run/build identity; any relevant build/index mutation invalidates prior Q1 evidence.

rows.why: A safe-looking route list can describe a foreign surface.
rows.invariant: Surface and entrypoint are bound to current candidate/publication and exact admitted build lineage.

rows.why: Reachability must fail closed for non-publishable or unverifiable candidates.
rows.invariant: Lab routes are never authorized; unknown/non-publishable state, missing/invalid receipt or authority, and undeclared entrypoint are denied.

rows.why: A PASS can become false after a relevant change without any malformed object.
rows.invariant: Changes to exact head/identity/route/authority/build invalidate the required Q5/Q6/Q1 evidence according to the governed invalidation table; unclassified mismatch blocks review.
rows.positiveCase: unchanged relevant domains retain eligible evidence

rows.why: Tooling dependencies can introduce vulnerabilities whose production reachability is unknown.
rows.invariant: Audit evidence classifies findings; production-reachable HIGH causes CI failure; tooling-only findings remain explicit evidence.
